ideas.title: Following the Money in the Feeding Our Future Fraud Scheme
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in the Feeding Our Future fraud scheme, including how it was stolen and where it was laundered.
ideas.insight: This story could help to shed light on the extent of the fraud scheme and how it was carried out. It could also help to identify potential suspects and motives.
